bullets.text: Smart Livestock Monitoring Launched — Boldyn Networks is deploying a private 5G network in West Sussex to enhance livestock monitoring, improving animal welfare and farm resilience amid extreme weather challenges.
Project Gigabit Progress Reported — Building Digital UK announced that over 296,000 premises have been connected under the £5 billion broadband initiative, improving internet access across the UK.

Huawei and HP Patent Agreement — Huawei and HP Inc. signed a global patent cross-licensing deal, enhancing collaboration in Wi-Fi technology and reflecting their commitment to innovation in the tech industry.
MWC26 Doha Co-Locates with ITU — The GSMA's MWC26 will occur alongside the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference, uniting global leaders to discuss digital policy and connectivity advancements.
